# lucidity_service_account_credential (Resource)

A client ID and secret for a lucidity_service_account, which a pipeline exchanges for access tokens. The secret is stored in Terraform state (marked sensitive): encrypt your state, and pass the secret straight to your secrets manager rather than outputting it. Credentials can't be changed, so any change creates a new one and revokes the old. When a credential expires or is revoked outside Terraform, the next refresh removes it and the next apply creates a new one (with a new secret).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lucidity_service_account_credential" "ci" {
  service_account_id = lucidity_service_account.ci.id
  name               = "github-actions"
  # expires_at       = "2027-06-30T00:00:00Z" # defaults to 90 days after creation
}

# Send the secret straight to a secrets manager instead of outputting it.
# When the credential expires or is revoked, the next apply creates a new
# one and this secret updates with it.
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "lucidity_ci" {
  secret_id = "lucidity/ci-deploy-bot"
  secret_string = jsonencode({
    client_id     = lucidity_service_account_credential.ci.client_id
    client_secret = lucidity_service_account_credential.ci.client_secret
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for the credential, e.g. where it's used.
- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the service account (lucidity_service_account.<name>.id).

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) When the credential stops working, as an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. `2027-01-04T00:00:00Z`); must be in the future. Defaults to 90 days after creation.
- `tenant_id` (String) Lucidity tenant ID (e.g. lucidity_tenant.<name>.tenant_id) to act on, sent as the X-tenant header. Overrides the provider's tenant_id; leave unset to use it. Needed when authenticating as a service account with roles on several tenants.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The client ID, for the provider's client_id setting or LUCIDITY_CLIENT_ID.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The client secret. Lucidity shows it only when the credential is created, so it's empty after `terraform import`.
- `created_at` (String) When the credential was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) "<service_account_id>/<token_id>". Also the import ID.
- `token_id` (String) Lucidity's ID for the credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "<service_account_id>/<token_id>". The client secret can't be
# recovered after creation, so client_secret is empty after import.
terraform import lucidity_service_account_credential.ci 3f1c9e2a-8b4d-4c1e-9a7f-2d5e6b8c0a11/896f7115d11b425583189b0cb0f19ee1
```
